en.headline: Fire at Causeway Bay subdivided flat leaves one woman hospitalised
en.dek: Flames broke out on the ninth floor of Hennessy Apartments on Tuesday morning; 73 people were evacuated and tram services were temporarily suspended.
body: A fire broke out at a subdivided flat on the ninth floor of Hennessy Apartments at 488-490 Hennessy Road in Causeway Bay shortly before 11 a.m. on Tuesday. Multiple calls were made to emergency services reporting smoke and flames.

Firefighters deployed breathing apparatus teams and a search-and-rescue unit. The blaze was extinguished around 12.27 p.m. Seventy-three residents and people from a bank on the ground floor were evacuated. One elderly woman was taken to hospital complaining of chest discomfort.

The Transport Department closed Percival Street between Hennessy Road and Leighton Road and temporarily suspended tram services on the Happy Valley loop. Initial information indicated the fire was caused by a short circuit and was not suspicious. Officers from Guangdong and Macao fire services, who are in Hong Kong for a joint training exercise, observed the operation.

zh.headline: 銅鑼灣軒尼詩大廈劏房起火 73人疏散一名老婦送院
zh.dek: 軒尼詩道488至490號單位今早起火，消防出動撲救，火警約中午12時半救熄，波斯富街一度全線封閉。
body: 銅鑼灣軒尼詩道488至490號軒尼詩大廈今早約10時59分有單位起火冒煙，警方接獲多個報案。消防派出搜救隊及煙帽隊撲救，火勢猛烈不時噴出火舌。
起火單位為9樓一劏房，初步相信由電線短路引起，並無可疑。火警至中午12時27分救熄，共73名住客及樓下銀行職員顧客疏散，一名老婦稱胸口不適送院。
運輸署宣布因火警封閉波斯富街介乎軒尼詩道與禮頓道一段，跑馬地電車服務暫停。廣東省及澳門消防人員正參與本港交流培訓，到場觀摩撲救工作。
